name: 整体闭环极限短时间引擎 v5.0.3 状态机
semantic_patch: T*=min(T_VALID) is the single machine-enforced objective and an always-present continuous control state
rule: SPEC_COMPLETE != IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE; VIRTUAL_COMPLETE requires both plus GPT verification and freeze completeness
invalid_by_construction: freeze manifest references a stale blob for any current frozen asset
run_verifier resolved before full remote source is materialized into the execution namespace
REAL dispatch without T_STAR_MS
REAL dispatch without T_VALID_START
REAL dispatch without T_VALID_END
REAL dispatch without T_STAR_SOURCE
REAL locator without machine-rendered T*
REAL PASS compared against a T* different from the frozen state
stale T* reused after REAL FAIL
new TIMELINE_ID created after REAL FAIL for the same task
TIME_ORIGIN_UTC changed during the same task
TIME_EVENT_SEQ does not equal append-only event count
time event order is non-contiguous
old TIME_EVENTS erased on retry
old certified best T_VALID erased on retry
active stale T* reused after REAL FAIL
engine state whose UNIQUE_ANCHOR is not exactly T*=min(T_VALID)
executable step without a renderable time-control snapshot
action with no continuous timeline identity
parallel ranking metric introduced beside T*=min(T_VALID)

real_dispatch_requires: Locator first line renders exact T*
time_anchor_contract.real_pass_rule: T_VALID_REAL_MS <= the exact frozen state T_STAR_MS
time_anchor_contract.real_fail_rule: return to VIRTUAL clears active time anchor so stale T* cannot be reused

time_ledger.invariant: One task owns one immutable TIMELINE_ID and TIME_ORIGIN_UTC across Virtual, Real, failures, retries and final certification.
state_fields: T_STAR_MS(active, may be PENDING in Virtual)
fail_semantics: clear only the active freeze T* to PENDING so stale T* cannot be reused

why_unique: VALID gates decide admissibility, not ranking
all valid candidates are ranked only by T_VALID
component times explain the bottleneck but cannot become parallel objectives
cost/quality/safety/correctness remain gates or task constraints unless the task definition explicitly changes
state_rule: Early Virtual: UNIQUE_ANCHOR is active with ANCHOR_STATE=PENDING
Virtual Freeze: ANCHOR_STATE=VIRTUAL_FROZEN and ACTIVE_T_STAR_MS is numeric
Reality Pass: ANCHOR_STATE=REAL_CERTIFIED and BEST_CERTIFIED_T_VALID_MS is updated
Reality Fail: same TIMELINE_ID persists; active T* returns to PENDING; history is retained
unique_anchor.executable_step_rule: Every executable step must pass authorize_executable_step() and produce render_time_control_snapshot().
